purpose: Prevent a verifier-window mismatch from clearing a deterministic prompt-injection finding outside the verifier-visible slice.

historical_failure.clearance_rule: verifier injection=false sets verdict clean and returns original input

required_current_tests.given: strong deterministic match wholly inside verifier-visible region
required_current_tests.must: not return unsafe original solely on an untrusted/low-assurance verifier response without explicit typed clearance policy

required_current_tests.given: strong deterministic match after initial verifier window in a long document
required_current_tests.must: ensure the verifier or independent checker receives the detected span plus context; unsafe original must not be returned

required_current_tests.given: multiple matches distributed across long input
required_current_tests.must: prove every detected span is covered by validation or remains neutralized
remain fail-closed and preserve provenance of why clearance was unavailable

required_current_tests.given: source display label contains words like test/smoke/sim
required_current_tests.must: derive trust from structured provenance, not attacker-influencable display text

required_current_tests.given: untrusted text stored under an otherwise internal filesystem prefix
required_current_tests.must: use provenance/content-boundary policy rather than pathname prefix alone to determine whether scanning can be skipped

acceptance_invariant: No untrusted-data path may transform DETECTED_UNSAFE into SAFE_ORIGINAL unless the clearing mechanism has actually evaluated the relevant evidence under an explicitly authorized typed policy.
